item.title: Barnacle Bill’s Sofia Tsantes steps away after 40 years
item.description: For 40 years, Adelaide’s Barnacle Bill’s at Plympton has been “home” to 72-year-old Sofia Tsantes, who with her late husband Paraschos became the nation’s first Barnacle Bill’s franchisees after taking over the store opened in 1970. She has run the business alone since losing Paraschos, also 72, to glioblastoma.
